outcome: `session_transaction` against an IPv6 base URL sets the session cookie on a host the following request will send it to

acceptance_criteria.text: Opening a session transaction against a bracketed IPv6 base URL, then requesting the same base URL, sees the value that was set.

expected_verification.assertion: a session value written inside session_transaction at an IPv6 base URL is readable from a subsequent request to it

acceptance_criteria.text: The existing behaviour for an ordinary host is unchanged, so the fix does not move where cookies are set for the common case.

expected_verification.assertion: the existing session-transaction tests still pass
